title: Single 2D Scientific Data Set (SDS) Radiance Image
description: Minimal NASA HDF4 DDL archive defining a 3x4 FLOAT32 top-of-atmosphere radiance Scientific Data Set with physical units and fill value.
code:
# NASA HDF4 Single 2D Scientific Data Set (SDS) Radiance Image
HDF4 Radiance_Image_L1B VERSION="4.2"
  ATTR Mission = "Terra"
  ATTR Instrument = "ASTER"

  SDS Band1_Radiance TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=10 UNIT="W/(m2.sr.um)"
    DIM lines = 3
    DIM pixels = 4
    ATTR scale_factor = 1.0
    ATTR add_offset = 0.0
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [42.1, 43.5, 45.0, 44.2, 41.8, 44.0, 46.3, 45.7, 40.9, 43.1, 45.4, 44.8]
  END
END

title: Multispectral 3-Band Satellite Reflectance Swath
description: Three-band (Red, NIR, SWIR) calibrated surface reflectance HDF4 SDS cube grouped inside an EOS Swath Vgroup for vegetation NDVI analysis.
code:
# Multispectral 3-Band Satellite Surface Reflectance Swath
HDF4 Landsat_Reflectance_Swath VERSION="4.2"
  ATTR Mission = "Aqua"
  ATTR Instrument = "MODIS"

  SDS Red_Reflectance TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=10 UNIT="1"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [0.06, 0.08, 0.14, 0.05, 0.09, 0.16]
  END

  SDS NIR_Reflectance TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=11 UNIT="1"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [0.42, 0.39, 0.25, 0.45, 0.37, 0.22]
  END

  SDS SWIR_Reflectance TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=12 UNIT="1"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [0.18, 0.21, 0.29, 0.16, 0.22, 0.31]
  END

  VGROUP ReflectanceSwath CLASS="SWATH" REF=40
    MEMBER SDS Red_Reflectance
    MEMBER SDS NIR_Reflectance
    MEMBER SDS SWIR_Reflectance
  END
END

title: Vdata Tabular Atmospheric Sounding Record
description: HDF4 archive combining a structured multi-field Vdata vertical atmospheric sounding table with a companion temperature profile SDS.
code:
# AIRS Atmospheric Vertical Sounding Vdata & Profile SDS
HDF4 AIRS_Sounding_L2 VERSION="4.2"
  ATTR Mission = "Aqua"
  ATTR Instrument = "AIRS"

  VDATA SoundingLevels CLASS="AtmosProfile" REF=20
    FIELD pressure_hPa : FLOAT32
    FIELD altitude_m : FLOAT32
    FIELD temperature_K : FLOAT32
    FIELD rh_percent : FLOAT32
    DATA [1000.0, 110.0, 290.5, 68.0]
    DATA [850.0, 1480.0, 281.2, 61.5]
    DATA [700.0, 3040.0, 272.0, 48.0]
    DATA [500.0, 5620.0, 255.4, 34.0]
    DATA [250.0, 10420.0, 222.8, 18.0]
  END

  SDS PressureGrid TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=21 UNIT="hPa"
    DIM levels = 5
    DATA [1000.0, 850.0, 700.0, 500.0, 250.0]
  END

  VGROUP SoundingProduct CLASS="PROFILE" REF=30
    MEMBER VDATA SoundingLevels
    MEMBER SDS PressureGrid
  END
END

title: Hierarchical Vgroup Sensor Calibration & Geolocation Cube
description: Multi-level HDF4 Vgroup hierarchy separating Geolocation SDS arrays, Radiance SDS data, and blackbody calibration telemetry Vdata under a root granule Vgroup.
code:
# Hierarchical HDF4 Sensor Calibration & Geolocation Granule
HDF4 Calibrated_Sensor_Granule VERSION="4.2"
  ATTR Mission = "Terra"
  ATTR Instrument = "MODIS"

  SDS Latitude TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=10 UNIT="degrees_north"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    DATA [37.1, 37.1, 37.1, 37.2, 37.2, 37.2]
  END

  SDS Longitude TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=11 UNIT="degrees_east"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    DATA [-122.4, -122.3, -122.2, -122.4, -122.3, -122.2]
  END

  SDS Thermal_IR_Radiance TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=12 UNIT="W/(m2.sr.um)"
    DIM lines = 2
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR scale_factor = 0.005
    ATTR add_offset = 0.1
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [8.42, 8.51, 8.39, 8.48, 8.55, 8.44]
  END

  VDATA BlackbodyCal CLASS="Calibration" REF=20
    FIELD scan_id : INT16
    FIELD bb_temp_K : FLOAT32
    FIELD gain_coeff : FLOAT32
    DATA [1, 290.15, 0.00501]
    DATA [2, 290.18, 0.00500]
  END

  VGROUP GeolocationFields CLASS="SWATH_GEOLOC" REF=30
    MEMBER SDS Latitude
    MEMBER SDS Longitude
  END

  VGROUP DataFields CLASS="SWATH_DATA" REF=31
    MEMBER SDS Thermal_IR_Radiance
    MEMBER VDATA BlackbodyCal
  END

  VGROUP GranuleRoot CLASS="SWATH" REF=40
    MEMBER VGROUP GeolocationFields
    MEMBER VGROUP DataFields
  END
END

title: MODIS-Style HDF-EOS Swath, Quicklook Raster & Telemetry Archive
description: Complete HDF-EOS Level-1B granule uniting calibrated multi-band SDS radiance, geolocation, 8-bit quicklook browse raster, orbit ephemeris Vdata, and nested Vgroups.
code:
# Complete NASA HDF-EOS MODIS Level-1B Granule Archive
HDF4 MOD021KM_A2026196 VERSION="4.2"
  ATTR Mission = "Terra"
  ATTR Instrument = "MODIS"
  ATTR Product = "MOD021KM"
  ATTR GranuleID = "MOD021KM.A2026196.1835.061"

  SDS EV_1KM_RefSB TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=10 UNIT="W/(m2.sr.um)"
    DIM lines = 3
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR scale_factor = 0.01
    ATTR add_offset = 0.0
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [112.4, 118.2, 121.0, 109.8, 115.6, 124.3, 106.5, 113.1, 119.7]
  END

  SDS EV_1KM_Emissive TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=11 UNIT="W/(m2.sr.um)"
    DIM lines = 3
    DIM pixels = 3
    ATTR scale_factor = 0.002
    ATTR add_offset = 0.0
    ATTR _FillValue = -999.0
    DATA [9.12, 9.25, 9.18, 9.04, 9.19, 9.31, 8.95, 9.10, 9.22]
  END

  SDS Latitude TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=12 UNIT="degrees_north"
    DIM lines = 3
    DIM pixels = 3
    DATA [36.0, 36.0, 36.0, 36.1, 36.1, 36.1, 36.2, 36.2, 36.2]
  END

  SDS Longitude TYPE=FLOAT32 REF=13 UNIT="degrees_east"
    DIM lines = 3
    DIM pixels = 3
    DATA [-121.0, -120.9, -120.8, -121.0, -120.9, -120.8, -121.0, -120.9, -120.8]
  END

  VDATA OrbitEphemeris CLASS="Ephemeris" REF=20
    FIELD tai_sec : FLOAT64
    FIELD alt_km : FLOAT32
    FIELD solar_zenith_deg : FLOAT32
    DATA [1058294100.0, 705.2, 26.4]
    DATA [1058294101.5, 705.2, 26.5]
    DATA [1058294103.0, 705.1, 26.6]
  END

  RASTER8 Quicklook_RGB8 WIDTH=3 HEIGHT=3 REF=30
    DATA [48, 72, 96, 64, 128, 160, 80, 144, 208]
  END

  VGROUP GeolocationGroup CLASS="SWATH_GEOLOC" REF=40
    MEMBER SDS Latitude
    MEMBER SDS Longitude
  END

  VGROUP ScienceGroup CLASS="SWATH_DATA" REF=41
    MEMBER SDS EV_1KM_RefSB
    MEMBER SDS EV_1KM_Emissive
  END

  VGROUP MODIS_SWATH_Type_L1B CLASS="SWATH" REF=50
    MEMBER VGROUP GeolocationGroup
    MEMBER VGROUP ScienceGroup
    MEMBER VDATA OrbitEphemeris
    MEMBER RASTER8 Quicklook_RGB8
  END
END
